description: This file defines the CalendarSyncOrchestrator class, responsible for orchestrating the synchronization of calendar accounts and events within a CRM system. It includes methods for retrieving calendar accounts, managing sync jobs, fetching and enriching events, discovering sync operations, executing event synchronization, and updating sync metadata. The class handles both synchronous and asynchronous operations, logs process details, and manages error handling.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOrchestrator
classes.description: A class that manages the overall process of calendar synchronization, including handling sync jobs, fetching events, discovering and executing sync operations, and updating sync status metadata.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Initiates synchronization of all calendar accounts, creating sync jobs based on configuration limits.

methods.name: getCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves and validates calendar accounts ready for synchronization.

methods.name: syncCalendarAccount
methods.description: Synchronizes a specific calendar account, either asynchronously via job creation or synchronously through direct operation.

methods.name: createAsyncAccountJob
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous job to handle calendar account synchronization, avoiding duplicate jobs.

methods.name: prepareProvidersAndQuery
methods.description: Prepares calendar providers and constructs the query object for event retrieval.

methods.name: fetchAndEnrichEvents
methods.description: Fetches events from external and internal sources and enriches them with linked events outside the sync window.

methods.name: discoverAndExecuteOperations
methods.description: Discovers sync operations between external and internal events and executes or queues them with throttling.

methods.name: finalizeSyncAccount
methods.description: Logs and updates metadata upon completion of a calendar account sync process.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Executes synchronization actions (create, update, delete) for individual calendar events, possibly via asynchronous jobs.

methods.name: updateLastSyncDate
methods.description: Updates the last successful sync timestamp on the calendar account metadata.

methods.name: updateLastSyncAttemptDate
methods.description: Records an attempt to sync, updating metadata with attempt timestamp and status.

methods.name: updateSyncAttemptResult
methods.description: Updates sync attempt status with success, partial, or warning based on operation results.

methods.name: updateSyncAttemptError
methods.description: Marks the sync attempt as failed with error status in account metadata.
